snippet.title: How I made Getting Over Goombas
snippet.description:
👾 Try it out: https://newbie-indie-game-dev.itch.io/getting-over-goombas
⭐ Get the source code on Patreon: https://patreon.com/NewbieIndieGameDev
😺 Join the Newbie Nexus on Discord: https://discord.gg/CkWXnH9utV
👾 Play some of my games: https://newbie-indie-game-dev.itch.io/

I made the ultimate platforming challenge! In this game, I merged the rage-inducing mechanics of Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy and the classic world of Super Mario Bros. The result is a hilariously painful platformer that will test your patience and skills. Developed using Unity, this game is not for the faint of heart. Can you handle it?

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

0:00​ Intro
0:21 Character design
0:39 Movement mechanic
1:48 Enemies
2:19 Power-ups
3:11 Level design
3:55 Gameplay
6:16 Outro

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

🎥 Video: Flor Niemevz 
https://www.behance.net/florenciamn

Graphic resources: www.vecteezy.com

Disclaimer: Getting Over Goombas is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with Bennett Foddy or Nintendo. The content and gameplay mechanics of this game are solely the creation of the developer. The use of any copyrighted material is intended solely for entertainment purposes, and all rights to such material are reserved by their respective owners.
